comment: Nice person, poor teacher. Doesn't know how to explain concepts in different ways. Has you do huge term project that is only small part of your grade, yet midterm and final compose 65% of grade. Can be condescending if you ask what she deems a simple question. Some coursework didn't seem relevant

Loved her! Makes sure everyone in class understands before moving on. Tests are hard, but she's crystal clear about what exactly will be covered on midterms. Aplia assignments are tedious, but easy. Offers occasional extra credit. Not hard to do well if you work hard enough. Makes you love macro!

Even though I didn't do as well as I hoped, I thoroughly enjoyed her class. Though sometimes it felt fairly long, she was clear, helpful and always available. I learnt a lot in her class and she is one of my favorite professors. Love you DATTA
Good teacher, tried her best.  Lots of students didn't really seem to care, which isn't her fault.

Great prof. She wants you to do well and is willing to work with you.  1 quiz every week keeps you on top of your stuff.  Tests are fair and not too hard.  I would take her again if possible.  She was great and I think you ought to take her

easy, accessible, friendly. definitely a great professor to have in the B-School. She's extremely well spoken and clear when explaining new concepts. exams are easy and require minimal studying, just read over the notes she gives you. great professor. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED

GREAT PROFESSOR! She is clear and makes sure everyone understands the material which can sometimes be difficult. Have 1 quiz a wk that keeps you on top of your stuff if you put in the effort. Gives out note packets for every chapter that are great and you follow along with in class. Available outside of class. One of the best professor I've had.

She is by FAR THE BEST PROFESSOR in the B school! She is well-prepared and organized! She makes herself available at your disposal and desires to see you do well and will help you on any way! HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!

I guess she got a lot better because I think she is one of the best professors I have had so far at U of R.  I was really surprised when I read the bad reviews, because I didn't agree with any of them.  She must have changed for the better.  Definitely sign up for her class

I'm surprised shes back after the reviews our class gave her last semester. She thinks that lecturing is standing in front and reading from the book, and gets angry and frustrated when people are confused and ask questions.  Tests are hard, and she'll catch and penalize everything that isn't perfect.  I advise you to stay away.

Very young, unexperienced teacher. Started off with very easy test and then surprised everyone with very difficult test. She is somewhat hard to understand with her accent/phrasing. Class is boring. She works hard so I imagine her classes will improve in the future
